'''Nar Shaddaa's Undercity''', also known as the '''lower levels of Nar Shaddaa''' or simply '''Lower Nar Shaddaa''', was the lower levels of the Vertical city of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Resting deep below the towering structures comprising Nar Shaddaa's [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], the Undercity was home to [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] owned by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], until its [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|demise]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. During her teenage years, the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Hylo Visz]] worked in the shipyards as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]]. It was also home to the [[Evocii]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Evocar]] and the native Nar Shaddaa inhabitants, the [[Gank/Legends|Ganks]]. Just as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had endured the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], and never revisit it, he did the same with Nar Shaddaa's Undercity. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] the Undercity was ultimately destroyed along with the rest of the moon's surface by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
